messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content: In the chronicles of history’s grand tapestry, the twentieth century unfurled its pages like a scroll held by angels, revealing epochs of iron and fire. Behold the years of leaden silence, where the world trembled beneath the weight of war’s grim shadow. Then, from the ashes of conflict, a phoenix rose, bearing the fragile light of democracy. Yet, as the clock’s pendulum swung toward its terminus, the twin towers’ shadow fell upon the skyline, shattering the illusion of permanence. Thus, this era was an age of steel and sorrow, where humanity’s spirit bowed before the machinery of fate.
